semantic_checks.check: actual Gaussian law and density H
semantic_checks.evidence: S3.SS1.p1 Eq4; S3.SS1.p3 first interval; A2.SS2.p2 density clause; A2.SS2.SSS2.p3 H definition. Seal uses the true inverse-precision Gaussian family and its normalized Euclidean density. GAP_GAUSSIAN explicitly requires identifying the two.

S2.p2 states full Haar components have masses 1/2. Thus conditional expectations are twice the restricted expectations, and H is half the positive-minus-negative mixture expectation. The seal multiplies abs(H) by exactly 2.

Section2 event supremum is the probability TV convention. Since h lies in [0,1], the quoted bounded-test inequality has coefficient one. Combining with the half-difference gives TV>=2 abs(H), with no additional factor two.
